title: Tunisian Oven Roasted Tofu
description: A keto-friendly dish featuring roasted tofu, perfect for a quick and easy meal. Inspired by the flavors of Tunisia, this recipe combines spices and herbs for a unique and delicious taste.

ingredients.name: Tofu
ingredients.notes: Extra-firm, drained, and cut into 1-inch cubes

ingredients.name: Spices (Tunisian Mix)
ingredients.notes: A blend of cumin, coriander, paprika, and cayenne pepper

instructions: In a shallow dish, whisk together olive oil, spices, garlic powder, salt, black pepper, dried oregano, and paprika.
Add the cubed tofu to the marinade and toss to coat evenly.
Transfer the marinated tofu to a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Bake for 20-25 minutes or until the tofu is golden brown and crispy on the outside.
Remove the tofu from the oven and drizzle with lemon juice.
Garnish with chopped fresh parsley, if desired.
